name: io.github.UlyssesModel/kirk-mcp
title: Kirk — Unsupervised Structural Change Detection
description: Kirk is the first algorithm on Ulysses — an algorithmic primitive that computes the complete pairwise structure of a system in real time, unsupervised, on a CPU. Signals the moment structure breaks. The Kalman filter for the non-Gaussian, non-stationary world. First 100 inference units free per new account.
